dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000q8be](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000q8be) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 35.0 depth occurred on Jun 24 2025 34km SE of Santa Ana Island. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -11.041 longitude 162.6867. It impacted 4960 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
